executiveSummary: OT/ICS risk is elevated this cycle due to concurrent, actively exploited perimeter device vulnerabilities and a joint U.S. government warning about active probing and read/write attempts against Siemens S7 PLCs. Immediate focus is required on perimeter hardening, rapid patching of edge/management systems, and validation of IT-to-OT segmentation. Active campaign against Siemens S7 PLC families (S7-200/300/400/1200/1500) using S7comm over TCP/102 elevates risk of operational disruption in Energy, Water/Wastewater, and Critical Manufacturing. Security Advisory MikroTik RouterOS "MikroTrick" chain enables unauthenticated SSH console access; exploitation observed in the wild. These routers often sit on OT perimeters. Patch immediately and hunt for "user -2" and "ops" artifacts. Supporting Report WNC T-Mobile 5G Box IDU CPE: unauthenticated command injection and credential disclosure enable remote root takeover of site links used by OT. Vendor firmware 1.1.0.651412 fixes multiple CVEs. Security Advisory Check Point Security Management Server zero-day (CVE-2026-93616) exploited in targeted attacks; concurrent VPN certificate validation flaw (CVE-2026-85102). Compromise could alter firewall policy protecting ICS networks. View Article Advantech industrial gateways: critical unauthenticated command paths and management bypasses across EKI and WISE lines pose immediate OT disruption risk; public exploits exist for WISE-6610. CISA Bulletin Supporting Bulletin Additional actively exploited perimeters: Cisco Secure Email Gateway SQLi to RCE, Zyxel GS1900 switch overflow, and Linux kernel EoP added to CISA KEV-all provide credible pivot paths toward OT if boundaries are weak. View Advisory CISA Alert Siemens Industrial Edge Management (CVE-2026-18963, CVSS 9.1) allows unauthenticated account takeover of edge management; critical for manufacturing environments-patch and restrict exposure. ICS Advisory CISA red-team findings at a Water/Wastewater entity highlight AD/Entra ID weaknesses (ADCS ESC1, DCSync, SCCM pivots) enabling IT-to-OT movement without direct internet egress. Security Advisory Policy shift: Austria's new NIS2 law (NISG 2026) establishes the BCS and mandates cooperation with active government scans of "essential entities"-operators should prep processes and segmentation. View Article

items: WaterPlum (North Korea) targeted developers via malicious npm/VS Code projects, with large-scale theft and potential employer network pivot risk. View Article
NightEagle (APT-Q-95) leveraged valid VPN creds, Exchange CVE-2020-0688, tunneling tools, and BlueKeep for domain dominance-patterns that can reach OT if segmentation is weak. Incident Report
"MovieReaper" modular framework distributed via compromised torrents shows strong persistence and C2 design; block IoCs and P2P in enterprise. Research
Macfinger "ClickFix" campaign targets macOS for credential theft; block listed IOCs and enforce macOS EDR controls. Analyst Diary

relevance: This cycle features multiple direct OT risks: an active PLC-targeting campaign against Siemens S7 families; critical vulnerabilities in industrial gateways (Advantech EKI/WISE) and edge management (Siemens IEM); and widespread exploitation of network appliances and enterprise platforms that commonly sit on or protect OT perimeters. Combined with CISA red-team findings at a Water/Wastewater entity, defenders should assume that perimeter compromise can translate into credible IT-to-OT lateral movement without overt internet egress from OT zones. Controls should emphasize segmentation, strict jump-hosting, identity hardening, and rapid patching of edge and management planes.

items: Siemens Industrial Edge Management (CVE-2026-18963, CVSS 9.1) - unauthenticated remote account takeover. ICS Advisory
OpenPLC Runtime v3 (CVE-2026-88020) - XSS enabling session hijack and operator action manipulation; upgrade to v4 and isolate UIs. ICS Advisory
Advantech EKI gateways - unauth RCE, missing auth on management (TCP/5058), weak firmware validation. CISA Bulletin
Advantech WISE-6610 - public exploits for two command injections; update to 1.2.4_20260821. CISA Bulletin
Eclipse Arrowhead / Ditto (IIoT) - authz bypass and SSRF/policy injection risks across local clouds/Thing models. CISA Bulletin
Cisco Secure Email Gateway (CVE-2026-76461) - actively exploited SQLi to root RCE via crafted emails. JPCERT/CC
Microsoft SharePoint RCEs (CVE-2026-50522, CVE-2026-58644) - actively exploited; patch and rotate secrets as needed. CERT-FR Alert
Zyxel GS1900 switch overflow (CVE-2026-7273) - KEV-listed exploitation; remove public exposure and update firmware. CISA Alert
Linux kernel EoP (CVE-2025-39682) - KEV-listed exploitation; critical for OT-adjacent Linux hosts and jump servers. CISA Alert

descriptions: Exploit Public-Facing Application (T1190): Check Point Mgmt Server, SharePoint, Cisco SEG, Advantech gateways
Valid Accounts (T1078) and External Remote Services (T1133): VPN abuse and password resets; NightEagle use of valid VPN credentials
Abuse of Public/Trusted Services (T1102/T1090): Microsoft dev tunnels, rdp2tcp, port proxies
Credential Dumping (T1003.006 DCSync) and AD CS abuse (T1553.004): CISA red-team findings
Command and Scripting Interpreter (T1059), Ingress Tool Transfer (T1105): enterprise backdoors and loaders
ICS ATT&CK: Program Download (T0807), Modify Program (T0843), and Abuse of Native Device Protocols (S7comm) during PLC targeting

outlook72h: Patch/mitigate: Check Point Mgmt Server and VPN; Siemens IEM; Advantech EKI/WISE; MikroTik RouterOS; WNC 5G CPE; SharePoint; Zyxel GS1900; Linux kernel on OT-adjacent hosts. Containment: Remove internet exposure for PLCs and OT gateways; restrict management planes to jump hosts and allowlisted subnets. Hunt tasks: S7comm unauthorized writes; RouterOS "-2/ops" artifacts; Check Point anomalous web-service writes/policy changes; Cisco SEG email-triggered RCE activity; Zyxel unexpected logins/config changes. Identity hardening: Enforce MFA everywhere; review ADCS templates and privileged groups; monitor for DCSync and unusual Kerberos activity. Segmentation assurance: Validate IT-to-OT firewall rules, deny-by-default conduits, and absence of unintended pathways introduced by recent changes.
